plugin.name: Proceed 💬
plugin.description:
Norden UI is an interface overhaul that seamlessly merges three core principles: the clean functionality of modern design, the rustic feel of the Nords, and the sophisticated restraint of a muted, monochromatic color scheme. The result is a deeply immersive experience that feels both timeless and current, pulling you deeper into the world of Tamriel without ever breaking your focus. It's based on my previous UI - Oathvein synthesizing the best elements of Dear Diary Dark Mode, Edge UI, Nordic UI, New Horizon UI, and Horizon UI Remake into a cohesive new vision.
⚠️ To proceed with installation You need to select "Proceed"!
Essential files for a standard 16:9 aspect ratio, redesigned with the clean, rustic aesthetic of Norden.
Essential files for an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, crafted to maintain Norden's immersive and focused design on wider screens.
